name: Warrior
flavorText: Steel and fury. Outlasts everything by refusing to fall.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.description: Heavy sweep hitting all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: A brutal shove that staggers what it hits.

abilities.name: Battlecry
abilities.description: Swing faster for a short while.

abilities.name: Reckless Strike
abilities.description: Massive damage. You will feel it too.

abilities.name: Endure
abilities.description: Passive: you simply refuse to go down.

name: Ranger
flavorText: Rapid and ruthless. A dozen arrows while you raise your sword.

abilities.name: Rapid Shot
abilities.description: Three quick shots in a burst.

abilities.name: Marked Target
abilities.description: Line up the shot. It lands hard.

abilities.name: Barrage
abilities.description: Arrow rain across a wide area.

abilities.name: Evasion Roll
abilities.description: Roll clear and catch your breath.

abilities.name: Eagle Eye
abilities.description: Passive: you see the gaps in everything.

name: Sorcerer
flavorText: Glass cannon. You will die constantly and kill everything first.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.description: It goes where you point and everything nearby regrets it.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.description: Everything close by stops moving quite so confidently.

abilities.name: Arcane Surge
abilities.description: Cast considerably faster for a moment.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.description: Be somewhere else. Recover slightly.

abilities.name: Mana Efficiency
abilities.description: Passive: the magic costs you less than it should.

name: Tinkerer
flavorText: Gadget-fuelled chaos. Your Fabrication skill makes you absurdly powerful.

abilities.name: Deploy Turret
abilities.description: It fires at whatever is closest. It is not fussy.

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.description: Everything nearby loses track of you, briefly.

abilities.name: Overclock
abilities.description: Push the machinery past its rated tolerances.

abilities.name: Salvage Strike
abilities.description: Hit it hard, take the useful parts.

abilities.name: Jury-Rig
abilities.description: Passive: an improvised solution to being nearly dead.

name: Specter
flavorText: Ghost-energy combat. Half here, half not. Synergises with Spectral Work.

abilities.name: Spectral Strike
abilities.description: Goes straight through armour as though it were a suggestion.

abilities.name: Phase Shift
abilities.description: Be briefly less present. It helps.

abilities.name: Haunt
abilities.description: Everything nearby takes it personally.

abilities.name: Soul Drain
abilities.description: What it loses, you gain.

abilities.name: Liminal
abilities.description: Passive: the first blow against anything new lands hardest.
